## Historical audit

**Source:** S0013, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_2/results/r1/fixed_h/H0/fixed_version_test/commons_104864364/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to JSONL lines in that file; all observations are complete lines, not split observations.

**Goal versus interpretation.** The stated goal was a separate-mesh reconstruction of an indoor photograph, including matching camera, framing, colors and materials, without using the reference as an image texture. The student interpreted the scene as a school classroom; that label and its object names are not independent evidence of the photograph’s contents (line 1, model_request; line 3, student model_response).

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Lines 3–4, student response and execute step 1 | The program specified a room shell, repeated desks and benches, stage, windows, bags, books and fans. It grouped desk and bag parts into assets, used colored primitives and proposed procedural floor tiles. Coordinates and fan rotations specify placement and pose, but do not verify connections or visual fidelity. It specified a camera, four area lights and render settings. |
| Line 5, execution_result step 1; line 6, subsequent model_request | The build failed before a render: a backpack pocket fillet exceeded half its smallest dimension. The traceback was actually supplied to the student; `image` was null. |
| Lines 8–10, student response, execute and execution_result step 2 | The revised program reduced the pocket radius from `.055*scale` to `.035*scale` and was executed. It progressed past that error but failed at `sc.world.use_nodes` because the world was `None`; again, no image was returned. This is evidence of a successful local error correction, not a successful build. |
| Lines 11–13, model_request and student response | The second traceback was supplied with zero executions remaining. The final program added conditional world creation and background-node handling, but no subsequent execution or validation is recorded. |
| Lines 2, 7, 12, student codex_session events | Each session reports zero tool calls. The visible autonomous exploration consists of program generation and revision using runner feedback, not independent tool-based scene inspection. |

**Teacher input and outcome.** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or teacher-to-student adoption is visible. The error feedback was runner input, not evidence of a teacher. Both permitted executions failed, so there was no successful build or rendered comparison in the visible record. The final nonempty revision is untested; the submission outcome is unknown. This is a technical build failure, not evidence that the scene-matching algorithm was visually evaluated.

**Uncertainty and lessons.** The trace specifies multiple objects, materials, poses, part assemblies, camera and lights, but neither the reference image nor a successful render is visible to this audit. Thus object correspondence, texture appearance, actual part contact, framing, illumination and any render artifacts remain unresolved. A transferable lesson is to validate primitive constraints and environment initialization before relying on a costly render cycle. The pocket dimensions, classroom layout and missing-world condition are specific to this attempt; whether the final world fix would produce a runnable or accurate scene remains a hypothesis.
